run_basis: Fresh independent computation from the cached, reader-validated snapshot on CPU.

counted_unit.protein_pair: Unordered pair of the exact, nonempty Protein 1 and Protein 2 labels in the validated primary row value.
counted_unit.measurement_rule: A row counts toward its protein pair only when at least one parsed affinity is present. Rows without both protein labels remain in archive counts but not pair counts.
counted_unit.label_rule: Strip surrounding whitespace only; do not merge aliases or infer labels from overflow fragments.

partner_rule.definition: Count distinct opposite protein labels across counted rows for each protein.
partner_rule.one_partner: A protein measured with exactly one partner has no alternative-partner margin in this table.
partner_rule.comparable_pair: Both proteins in the counted pair must each have more than one distinct measured partner.

excluded_by_design: Any prediction of selectivity for a protein the table does not measure.
Any claim that a protein with one measured partner is selective.
Any ranking of proteins by measurement or partner counts.
Any estimate of a selectivity margin from this census.
